This comment uses the AI-jargon phrase "carve-out", which is on the banned-phrases list. It refers to `isSettled`'s own internal exclusion logic (an Expensify function, not an external API), so the exception for third-party/external identifiers does not apply. CONSISTENCY-17 applies to comments including in tests.

Replace "carve-out" with plain language such as "exclusion" or "exception":

```ts
// isSettled's exclusion; stateNum stays SUBMITTED so isReportApproved/isClosedReport don't mask it.
```

The comment uses the banned AI-generated word "sentinel", which rarely appears in code written by engineers. Use plain language such as "placeholder", "marker", or "guard entry" instead.

Rewrite the comment to describe report "0" without the jargon, e.g.:
```ts
 * the "0" placeholder rather than a real report, so paging onto it lands the user on an empty report, and it inflates
```

The variable name `getterSentinel` uses the banned AI-jargon term "sentinel", which reads as chatbot-generated rather than engineer-written. This rule applies to variable names and is not exempt in test files.

Rename it to plain, direct language such as `getterError` or `getterMarker`:

```ts
const getterError = new Error('status getter failed');
```

Update the two later references (`throw getterSentinel;` and `outcome === 'throw' ? getterSentinel : callable`) to match the new name.

The term "sentinel" ("re-auth sentinel") is AI-generated jargon on this rule's banned list. It refers to the app's own `CF_REAUTH_REQUIRED` value (an internal concept, not an external spec/API name), so it should use plain language.

Replace "sentinel" with "marker" or "guard value", e.g.:

```ts
it('rejects with the re-auth marker and does not retry when the refresh outcome is terminal', async () => {
```

This added comment uses the banned AI-jargon phrase "fan-out", which reads like chatbot prose rather than engineer-written code. Replace it with plain, direct language.

```ts
//   - snapshot data with no `state` is terminal too: the IOU optimistic write adds data without the state field
```

This comment uses the banned AI-jargon phrase "belt-and-suspenders", which rarely appears in engineer-written code and makes the codebase sound machine-generated.

Replace it with plain language, e.g.:
```tsx

```
